goal: Implement Lesson Builder Core in dau-viet-backend: structured draft_json (v1 schema) holding stages/activities/rules/transitions/evidence-refs, redesigned DraftValidator with SAVE+PUBLISH levels and per-ActivityType validator registry, sub-resource admin endpoints for stage/activity CRUD+reorder, Evidence admin CRUD with DRAFT→APPROVED→ARCHIVED lifecycle, and a publish-readiness POST /api/v1/admin/lessons/{id}/validate returning structured field-level errors. All mutations honour expectedRowVersion optimistic lock; all endpoints CONTENT_ADMIN.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Stage admin endpoints under /api/v1/admin/lessons/{id}/draft/stages: list, get, create (auto-id or client-supplied), PATCH (type+id immutable), DELETE (cascades activities and prunes nextStageIds/completion.requiredStageIds refs), PUT order with full orderedIds[]. All mutations validate SAVE-level DraftValidator, honour expectedRowVersion, return standard error envelope.

Activity admin endpoints nested under stages: list/get/create/patch/delete/reorder. Stage→activity allow-list enforced (e.g., MULTIPLE_CHOICE not allowed under CONTEXT) -> 422 STAGE_ACTIVITY_MISMATCH.

Type-aware config validation via ActivityConfigValidator registry bean: one validator per ActivityType (READ, VIEW_IMAGE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, EXPLORE_MAP, EVIDENCE_SELECT, MATCHING, REASONING_CONNECT, HYPOTHESIS_CHOICE, DRAG_ORDER, VERIFICATION, CER, REFLECTION_PROMPT); unsupported type -> 422 UNSUPPORTED_ACTIVITY_TYPE.

Evidence admin endpoints /api/v1/admin/evidences: list (eventId+status+q+pagination), create (eventId+sourceTitle required, assetId optional existence-checked), get, patch (refused when ARCHIVED), approve (DRAFT->APPROVED), archive (refused with 409 EVIDENCE_IN_USE when referenced by published lesson_versions.snapshot_json). V6 migration adds evidences.row_version for optimistic lock.

Transition integrity: stages[].nextStageIds must reference existing stage IDs (422 UNKNOWN_STAGE_ID otherwise); self-loops and multi-stage cycles detected (422 CIRCULAR_TRANSITION); at least one reachable terminal stage at publish level.
Unique stable IDs enforced: stage IDs unique in stages[]; activity IDs unique within stage. Violations produce FieldError with path stages[i].activities[j].id and code DUPLICATE_ID.
Concurrent edits safe: stale expectedRowVersion -> 409 OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_CONFLICT on stage/activity/evidence mutations.
Incomplete drafts saveable: SAVE-level validation tolerates missing config/instruction/empty stages[]; structural violations (non-object, bad id shape, unknown type) still rejected.

Publish-readiness POST /api/v1/admin/lessons/{id}/validate returns 200 with {ready, errors[] with path+code+message, warnings[], summary{stages,activities,evidenceRefs}}; performs no mutation, no lesson_versions insert; centralQuestion+objectives+template.schemaVersion checked at lesson level.
Auth: all new endpoints require CONTENT_ADMIN; LEARNER -> 403; anonymous -> 401; public GET /api/v1/events* unchanged.

Tests + regression: ITs for stage/activity/evidence/validate endpoints and DraftValidatorTest unit suite (no Spring) green; existing AuthRefreshIT/AdminEventIT/AdminLessonIT/FlywayMigrationIT still pass; mvnw verify exit 0; no fake data or mocks to pass build; docs/API_SPEC + docs/DATABASE_DESIGN updated.
